Description: Sensitive employee or customer data may be exposed to an AI service.
Mitigation: Data minimization, approved tools, access controls and privacy review.

Description: GenAI tools may produce plausible but incorrect answers.
Mitigation: Source grounding, citations, confidence thresholds and human review.

Description: AI-assisted people decisions may disadvantage certain groups.
Mitigation: Keep human decision authority, test outcomes, document limitations.

Description: Enterprise data could be leaked through prompts, connectors or weak permissions.
Mitigation: Private deployment options, least-privilege access and security testing.

Description: Incomplete or inconsistent data can reduce model performance.
Mitigation: Data-quality checks, clear data ownership and pilot baselines.

Description: Employees may avoid the tool if it does not fit the real workflow.
Mitigation: Co-design pilots with users, training, feedback loops and simple UX.

Description: Connecting AI tools to ERP, CRM or OT systems may take longer than expected.
Mitigation: Start with low-integration pilots and validate interfaces early.

Description: A solution may become hard to move or expensive to scale.
Mitigation: Prefer modular architecture, exportable data and contract review.
